## What this branch cost

This is lane W of the 17 October intake pass (epic think-e2sz): stages 0 and 1 of every new item since the 16 October pass, plus a regularization audit. It was one sub-agent lane of about 70 minutes, from 06:38Z to 07:45Z on the shared four-core host. The work was:

- three online sweeps, about a minute each;
- 8.5 MB of release tarballs fetched to price #446's comment;
- two paired renders, 8 minutes, to back two no-public-change records;
- the records tier, 198 s, and 211 focused tests, 132 s.

The branch is records only. It registers nothing, retains no packet, runs no replay or regularization, and cuts no edition. It moves the data pin once, and it posted nothing on GitHub apart from the `intake` label on #659 and #664.

## Results and Dispositions

| Work or result | What was established | Evidence | Why it stopped | Disposition and follow-up |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| #659, Evan Daniel, s(236) ≤ 15.861934390608 (evand `5ad0069`) | The certificate side is 7930967195303679308621899285697/(5·10^29). It is 2.0213565519e-3 below both case lanes (T-146) and below T-174, which is staged there. It is the latest report at 236, so the report-order rule records it, as a new packing continuing itsnaka's #481 arrangement by the source's words. The .cert SHA-256 matches the issue. Once validated it moves the house at 236 | Triage in think-6wtz: claims, map, ledger reading, price and draft acknowledgement | Stage 1 done | continue: stages 2 to 4 in think-6wtz. The replay is about a CPU-minute on the two maintained exact routes plus the source's two stdlib checkers. Adoption and regularization of 236 follow, at about 0.2 CPU-h |
| #664, Evan Daniel, s(271) ≤ 16.948947733714 (evand `757b40b`) | The certificate side is 16948947733713657510723401112423/10^30, 4.4622737548e-5 below both case lanes (T-186). It is the latest report at 271, so it is recorded. Once validated it moves the house at 271 | Triage in think-8o5j | Stage 1 done | continue: stages 2 to 4 in think-8o5j, the same route and price as #659. The owner and author question below decides its credit |
| #446, wand125's comment of 16 October (21 fine-net lower bounds) | n = 37, 39 and 44 are already T-178, T-176 and T-177. The 18 new ones, at n = 38, 40, 41, 43, 51, 68, 84 to 86, 88 to 92 and 106 to 110, are each above both lower lanes, by 0.0115 to 0.09 (and 0.099 to 0.143 at 106 to 110 against T-180's closed form). All 18 release tarballs match their ASSET.json SHA-256 | Triage in think-f40c, with per-count price from each bundle's own receipt | Stage 1 done | continue: stages 2 and 3 in think-f40c. The census is priced at 82.6 to 94.9 CPU-h in all, 0.6 to 25 each; every item is under the 40 CPU-h item cap, and the total is the owner's call. It also needs the owner's #543 answer on retaining check2 candidates |
| #432, closed on GitHub, open here | The owner closed it at 2026-10-16T18:41:59Z without a comment. The entry now reads closed, with a note | `check_requests --github` and the issue's events | Done | retire-success. The final comment drafted in think-klm7 is unposted, and whether to post it is the owner's call |
| ofitzharding/sq19 `c86a991` | The author's clean rebuild of v1.0.0 passed: VERIFIED, 13,143 modules kernel-replayed with no failure, 64 vCPU × 5 h 18 min. This is new evidence for T-194, not a replay here | Watch read naming think-a4x3 | Read | continue: think-a4x3 retains it. It is a measure for think-nqnl's held rebuild |
| wand125/square-packing `319a779..fbc5fc4` (38 commits) | The 18 certificates (read naming think-f40c). The AB − 5 rectangle theorem in Lean, whose square case is T-081's lower half by a second Lean route (think-jh0n). Closed-form Lean layer A, conditional on the 34 local covers (T-180, think-tsox). Cubes in 3 to 6 dimensions and site commits are outside the record | Three watch reads | Read | continue in each named bead |
| evand/square-packing `7d1407a..757b40b` (5 commits) | The #659 and #664 certificates, plus packer notes whose live hunts found nothing else below the register | Two watch reads | Read | continue: think-6wtz and think-8o5j |
| Resolved waits | think-3q9x (#660 merged), think-mu5v and think-tk0u (#647 merged) | A `blocked_on: none` note on each | Done | think-3q9x resumes in #658's lane. think-tk0u can close. think-mu5v's remaining final comments are #470, #529 and #584 |
| Hand-read sources | UnitSquare Release 1's page and data are byte-identical to the retained copies (`4cc4d80d…`, `dd7c1c62…`). SQUISH n153's comment still carries its 2026-10-07T18:33:04Z edit | `curl` and `gh api` | Read | Reviewed dates move to 2026-10-17 |
| Kingbird capture of 2026-10-17 | 0 counts differ from the record's capture of 2026-10-05 | `make intake` | Read | none |

**The closing sweep** at this branch (`intake_sweep`, online) exits 0. It finds no item without an open bead and no resolved blocker, and 88 items are owned. Not Checked lists only the two hand-read sources, reviewed today. The note that franciscouzo's and TheSnakeFang's reads "can be removed" is think-ffh8's known defect; removing either exposes unretained commits, as the 16 October lane measured.

**Owner and author questions.**
1. **#664's classification.** The source calls it a refinement of Couzo's #561 packing, which the register credits as a regularization. It is also a distinct local minimum, with one fewer load-bearing tilted square and 59 squares moved by more than 1e-4. Either way it is recorded; the question decides only the credit.
2. **#446's census total.** It is 83 to 95 CPU-h. A first subset under 40 is the 13 counts at 68 to 110 plus n = 38, about 25 to 28 CPU-h.
3. **#432.** The owner closed it without the drafted final comment: should the comment still be posted?

### Regularization audit

The audit read `default_drawings --check-state` on this branch, which carries `main`'s drawings, with and without `--base-ref origin/main`. Both pass with 0 pending, `PENDING_ALLOWED` empty, and 73 regularized, 232 regular as published, 15 decided no better and 4 exempt. The sweep's **Regularization owed** lists only the four exemptions (think-yk2h).

59 counts draw an irregular picture, meaning a light, uneven or near-axis square. Open lanes cover 40 of them: #658 covers T-193's counts 88, 102, 123, 126, 175, 204, 232, 258, 259 and 292, and think-3mry's T-174 adoption covers 30 more. #661 (29) draws a regular view. That leaves these 19:

| n | state | drawn by | light / uneven / near-axis | bead | planned strong-generator runs | CPU-h |
|---:|---|---|---|---|---|---:|
| 290, 291 | exempt | house | 4 / 31 / 0 each | think-yk2h | the full set, after think-yk2h gives an exact witness (the 36-digit Kingbird pose overlaps at dilation 1) | 0.4 |
| 55, 39 | exempt | house | 2 / 6 / 0; 1 / 3 / 0 | think-yk2h | the same | 0.4 |
| 171, 198 | regularized | Daniel's driver | 4 / 15 / 0 each | think-yk2h, think-drze | grid-slack at 0.5, 1 and 5° once an exact frame exists; the axis tool and grid-slack refuse the decimal pose | 0.4 |
| 71, 41, 83 | regularized | Daniel's driver | 3 / 5 / 0; 1 / 3 / 0; 2 / 0 / 0 | think-yk2h | the same | 0.6 |
| 271 | regularized | grid-slack 0.5° | 6 / 10 / 0 | think-8o5j | none on this witness: #664 re-houses 271, and the full set runs in that adoption PR | 0.2 |
| 303, 264, 176 | decided / regularized / decided | axis / grid-slack / axis | 4 / 15 / 0; 3 / 15 / 0; 4 / 8 / 0 | think-drze | none: the driver and grid-slack at 0.5, 1 and 5° all decided this witness on 16 October (3a, 3c and z7wn runs), so re-running them repeats the result | 0 |
| 211, 237, 304 | regularized / decided / decided | driver / axis / axis | 2 / 10 / 3; 5 / 9 / 1; 0 / 4 / 5 | none (proposed: think-drze) | none, for the same reason. These three still draw near-axis squares | 0 |
| 154, 156, 146 | regularized | grid-slack / grid-slack / driver | 4 / 9 / 0; 2 / 4 / 0; 1 / 0 / 0 | none (proposed: think-drze) | none, for the same reason | 0 |

The planned total is **2.0 CPU-h over 10 counts**, and 9 of the 10 wait for exact witnesses (think-yk2h). Three more runs are owed when houses move:

- 236 on #659's witness, in its adoption PR (0.2);
- 70, 153 and 207 when T-174's algebraic houses are adopted (think-ot5c; 0.6).

That makes **2.8 CPU-h** in all. Re-running all 19 regardless would cost 3.8 CPU-h, but 9 of those reproduce decisions already recorded on the current witness. What remains for those 9 is think-drze's open owner question: accept them as drawn, or ask for a generator beyond grid-slack's trust region.

## Changes by Purpose

| Area | Result | Principal files or interfaces |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Requests record | #659 and #664 enter at triage, each with one queued result, an import bead and the answer bead. #446 reads its 16 October comment (`read_through` at the 09:00:31Z edit) and maps 3 registered and 18 queued results. #432 is closed | `packing/campaign/result-requests.yaml` |
| Watch reads | Six reads (evand ×2, sq19, wand125 ×3), each naming the bead that holds what it found | `packing/campaign/intake-watch.yaml` |
| Source register | UnitSquare Release 1 and SQUISH n153 reviewed on 2026-10-17, with a note on each read | `packing/frontier/source-coverage.yaml` |
| Release history | Two no-public-change records. The methods survey: 42 files byte-identical at link revision `804eff36`, comparing `main`'s requests record and register with the branch's. The site: 1472 files byte-identical, comparing `main`'s register with the branch's. `DATA_REVISION` is re-pinned to `eb51cf5a` (release rule 1) | `packing/src/sqpack/release.py` |

## Validation

- Local, at `a5b5f0ec2` unless noted:
  - `packing-validate --records`: exit 0, 52 of 110 steps, 197.9 s of a 300 s ceiling. It ran at `eb51cf5a7`'s tree, before the commit and before the re-pin, with the local bead store.
  - `intake_sweep` (online, at `eb51cf5a7`'s tree): exit 0.
  - `check_requests`: passes.
  - `default_drawings --check-state` and `--check-state --base-ref origin/main`: pass.
  - `release_pin --check`: "the pin is the last data commit, eb51cf5a76d8".
  - `check_release_impact --baseline-ref origin/main`: every publication candidate has a reviewed disposition.
  - Renders: `render_packing_methods --revision 804eff36…` and `render_overview --output`, each once with `main`'s two inputs and once with the branch's; `diff -rq` finds both sets identical.
  - `pytest -n 2` on test_release, test_release_components, test_release_impact, test_release_pin, test_check_requests, test_intake_sweep, test_source_coverage and test_cut_release: 210 passed, 1 skipped, in 132 s.
  - Not run: `packing-validate --push`, which exceeds its wall caps on this shared host. Hosted CI is the `--fast` gate.
- Hosted, at `a5b5f0ec2`: green. Packing validation (run 39013991317), Certificate page (run 39013991266) and Branch mergeability (run 39013719999) succeeded. Of 83 check runs, 31 succeeded and 52 were skipped, none failed; the successes include `validate`, `suite-a` to `suite-d`, `typecheck`, `frontend`, `sweeps`, `merges-into-base`, `packing-required` and `pages-required`. One Deferred checkpoint run (39014002020) was cancelled, superseded by a newer run of the same workflow. The four new beads were on `origin/tbd-sync` before the run. GitHub reports the PR mergeable and clean.

## Documentation and Replanning

- Documentation review: no reader document changes.
- Selected next entry: the import lanes for think-6wtz and think-8o5j (minutes of CPU each, then adoption plus about 0.2 CPU-h of regularization each), and think-f40c's stages 2 and 3.
- Deferred candidates: think-f40c's census (owner: the total and #543); think-yk2h's exact Kingbird witnesses (9 audit counts); think-drze's owner question (12 audit counts).
- Release impact: the site edition stays v0.7.25 and no edition is cut. A branch that also edits the head of `RELEASE_NO_PUBLIC_CHANGES` takes both entries at merge. A branch that re-pins `DATA_REVISION` resolves that line with `release_pin --update` after the merge.
- [x] Labelled `S1`: bookkeeping only (triage entries, watch reads, a recorded closure). S1 stays out of News, so the changelog records a coverage omission.

## Limits

- Nothing here is imported or validated.
- The prices are estimates:
  - #659's and #664's replays scale T-187's measured 21 s by pair count;
  - #446's census uses each bundle's own receipt times this host's measured ratio of 0.871.
- The audit reads the recorded decisions and the retained 16 October run directories. For a regularized count drawn from a 12 October run, the record names only the drawn run, so "no run recorded" there means unrecorded, not unrun.
- No reply is drafted for posting before this PR merges. The acknowledgements are in the import beads.
